summaryEn: Full on-stage conversation with game designer Todd Howard about technology, gaming, cars and space.
summaryZh: 与游戏设计师托德·霍华德就技术、游戏、汽车和太空展开的完整台上对谈。

segments.textEn: >> AND NOW, ELON MUSK IN CONVERSATION WITH TODD HOWARD! PLEASE WELCOME YOUR MODERATOR! >> THIS IS GOING TO BE REALLY SPECIAL. E3 I THINK IS A SHOW ABOUT CELEBRATING GAMES BUT IT'S ALSO ABOUT TALKING ABOUT THE IMPACT GAMES HAVE ON THE WORLD AND PEOPLE FROM ALL WALKS OF LIFE TALKING ABOUT WHAT GAMES MEAN TO THEM.
segments.textZh: >> 现在，埃隆·马斯克与托德·霍华德展开对谈！有请你们的主持人！>> 这将会非常特别。我认为E3是一场庆祝游戏的展会，但它也关乎讨论游戏对世界产生的影响，以及各行各业的人讲述游戏对他们意味着什么。

segments.textEn: TODAY IT'S MY HONOR TO INTRODUCE ONE OF OUR INDUSTRY'S MOST RENOWNED DESIGNERS WITH AN INDIVIDUAL WHO IS CHARTING THE FUTURE OF THE WORLD IN SO MANY INCREDIBLE WAYS WHO ALSO HAPPENS TO BE A BIG GAMER. PLEASE WELCOME TODD HOWARD AND ELON MUSK! WELCOME TO E3! >> THANK YOU. >> WHEN WE ANNOUNCE THIS, THE BIGGEST QUESTION EVERYONE HAD WAS TO THESE GUYS KNOW EACH OTHER? YOU GUYS ARE FRIENDS, RIGHT? >> YEAH. >> HOW DID YOU GET TO KNOW EACH OTHER?
segments.textZh: 今天，我很荣幸地向大家介绍我们行业最负盛名的设计师之一，以及一位正以许多令人难以置信的方式勾画世界未来的人，而他碰巧也是一位资深游戏玩家。有请托德·霍华德和埃隆·马斯克！欢迎来到E3！>> 谢谢。>> 当我们宣布这件事时，大家最大的疑问是：这两个人认识彼此吗？你们是朋友，对吧？>> 是的。>> 你们是怎么认识彼此的？

segments.textEn: >> PEOPLE TRIED TO CONNECT US OVER SEVERAL YEARS, WE FINALLY CONNECTED I THINK WHEN I BOUGHT MY TESLA. AND SOMEBODY -- I WENT INTO THE STORE, YOU DON'T BUY TESLA, YOU ORDER THEM ONLINE. I CLICK THAT BUTTON WHEN ORDERING OUR TESLA AND THEN WE CONNECTED. >> I'VE BEEN A BIG FAN OF YOUR GAMES FOR A LONG TIME AND I PLAYED "FALL OUT 3," I PLAYED THAT GAME A LOT. I EXPLORED EVERY CORNER OF THAT GAME. I DID NOT COMPLETE "SKY ROOM."
segments.textZh: >> 几年来一直有人试图介绍我们认识，我想我们最终建立联系是在我买了我的Tesla时。然后有人——我走进店里，你不是在那里买Tesla，而是在网上订购。我在订购我们的Tesla时点击了那个按钮，然后我们就联系上了。>> 很长时间以来，我一直非常喜欢你的游戏，而且我玩过《辐射3》，那款游戏我玩了很久。我探索了那款游戏的每一个角落。我没有通关《天空房间》。

segments.textEn: AND THEN, I ASKED FOR THE DASH CAN I HAVE THAT STATUE OF THAT WEIRD LOOKING GUY WITH THE 1950s GUY? THAT GUY. LIFE-SIZED STATUE OF THIS 1950s JUMPSUIT. DO YOU HAVE THIS AT HOME? IT WAS SO WEIRD HAVING THAT WITH PARTY. TO PARTNER TO MAKE EVERYONE ELSE IS LIKE, THAT'S WEIRD. ROLLING BACK IN TIME, WHEN YOU WERE A KID, YOU PROGRAMMED A GAME, IS THAT TRUE? >> PRIMITIVE.
segments.textZh: 然后，我问仪表盘，我能要那个长相奇怪、带着1950年代家伙模样的雕像吗？就是那个人。这个穿1950年代连身服的真人大小雕像。你家里有这个吗？聚会时放着那个真是太奇怪了。为了搭档，让其他所有人都觉得，那很奇怪。回溯一下，你小时候编写过一个游戏，是真的吗？>> 很原始。

segments.textEn: IT I THINK I WAS PROBABLY TEN OR 11 WHEN I PROGRAMMED THAT GAME, IT'S A SIMPLE GAME. YOU ARE A SPACE FIGHTER, YOU FIGHT ALIENS. YEAH. I WROTE THAT GAME, THE GRAPHICS AND THE SOUND AND EVERYTHING. IT'S A VERY SIMPLE GAME. >> DID YOU EVER ASPIRE TO MAKE GAMES OR GET INTO MAKING GAMES? >> THAT WILL BE FUN. >> THERE WERE A FEW PLACES WHERE YOU KEPT DOING A LITTLE BIT OF GAMING STUFF.
segments.textZh: 我想我编写那个游戏时大概是10岁或11岁，那是个简单的游戏。你是一名太空战斗机驾驶员，你与外星人战斗。是的。我编写了那款游戏，包括图像、声音和所有东西。那是一款非常简单的游戏。>> 你是否曾立志制作游戏，或者进入游戏制作行业？>> 那会很有趣。>> 有几个地方，你一直在做一点游戏方面的事情。

segments.textEn: >> I WORKED AT A GAMING START UP WHICH WARILY WAS CALLED ROCKET SCIENCE. FADE TO LOVE'S IRONY. I WORKED AT ROCKET SCIENCE, IT WAS LONG TIME AGO. IT MUST HAVE BEEN '93, '94. IT WAS TRICKY. >> YOU NEVER APPLY TO BETHESDA, THOUGH? >> HE WAS DOING OTHER THINGS. >> MY ORIGINAL PLAN WAS TO GO TO GRAD SCHOOL AND DO STUDY FOR ELECTRIC VEHICLES, I ALWAYS WANTED TO DO ELECTRIC CARS AND WORK ON SUSTAINABLE ENERGY, I CAN SORT OF TALK A LITTLE BIT ABOUT IT.
segments.textZh: >> 我曾在一家游戏初创公司工作，它被谨慎地称为Rocket Science。淡入爱情的讽刺。我曾在Rocket Science工作，那是很久以前了。应该是'93年、'94年。那很棘手。>> 不过你从没申请过Bethesda？>> 他当时在做别的事情。>> 我最初的计划是去读研究生，研究电动汽车，我一直想做电动汽车，也想从事可持续能源方面的工作，我多少可以谈一点这件事。

segments.textEn: BASICALLY, WHAT OF THE THINGS I THINK ARE IMPORTANT FOR THE FUTURE, WE HAD TO HAVE SUSTAINABLE ENERGY, SUSTAINABLE CONSUMPTION OF ENERGY. SO THAT MEANS MAKING SOLAR PANELS LOW-COST AND ELECTRIC ELECTRIC CARS APPEALING. AND THEN WE WANT TO BE, MULTI-PLANET SPECIES, ROCKETS, AND THEN -- THERE IS A SOME THINGS I THOUGHT WOULD AFFECT THE FUTURE BUT I'M NOT SURE IF IT'S GOOD OR BAD, LIKE A I. THAT WORRIES ME, THAT ONE.
segments.textZh: 基本上，我认为对未来重要的事情是什么，我们必须拥有可持续能源、可持续的能源消耗。所以这意味着制造低成本的太阳能电池板，并让电动电动汽车具有吸引力。然后我们想成为，多行星物种，火箭，然后——有一些我认为会影响未来的事物，但我不确定这是好是坏，比如人工智能。那个让我担忧，就是那个。

segments.textEn: [LAUGHTER] >> I JUST MADE A VIDEO GAMES. I WAS GOING TO DO ALL THAT. BUT I ACTUALLY DON'T KNOW HOW TO DO THAT. >> THAT AI BASICALLY CAUSED WORLD WAR III, AS I RECALL. >> IS THERE A LINK THERE, YOU TALK ABOUT AI AND VIDEO GAMES AND THE TECHNOLOGY AND VIDEO GAMES, IS THERE ANYTHING THERE THAT SORT OF HELPS PUSH TECHNOLOGY THAT YOU THINK?
segments.textZh: [笑声] >> 我只是制作了电子游戏。我本来要做所有那些事。但我其实不知道该怎么做。>> 据我记得，那个人工智能基本上引发了第三次世界大战。>> 这里有什么联系吗？你谈到人工智能、电子游戏以及电子游戏中的技术，其中是否有什么东西在你看来能以某种方式帮助推动技术发展？

segments.textEn: YOU LOOK AT SELF-DRIVING CARS OR OTHER THINGS, ARE THERE THINGS FROM VIDEO GAMES YOU THINK HELP PUSH TECHNOLOGY FORWARD? >> PART OF THE REASON I GOT INTERESTED IN TECHNOLOGY, THE REASON WAS VIDEO GAMES. VIDEO GAMES ARE A POWERFUL FORCE FOR GETTING KIDS INTERESTED IN TECHNOLOGY, IT HAS A BIGGER EFFECT THAN PEOPLE REALIZE. IF WE ARE INTERVIEWING SOMEBODY FOR SOFTWARE ENGINEERING, MANY TIMES, HOW DID YOU START PROGRAMMING? "VIDEO GAMES."
segments.textZh: 看看自动驾驶汽车或其他东西，你认为电子游戏中是否有什么东西帮助推动了技术进步？>> 我对技术产生兴趣的部分原因，那个原因就是电子游戏。电子游戏是让孩子对技术产生兴趣的一股强大力量，它产生的影响比人们意识到的更大。如果我们在面试某个人的软件工程职位，很多时候会问，你是怎么开始编程的？“电子游戏。”

segments.textEn: I THINK MANY OF THE BEST SOFTWARE ENGINEERS IN THE WORLD ARE AT OR SPENT MUCH OF THEIR CAREER AT VIDEO GAMES HOUSES AND ESPECIALLY IF PEOPLE HAD TO TRY TO CREATE REALISTIC GRAPHICS USING VERY LITTLE COMPUTE POWER, THAT'S A HARD PROBLEM AND SO A LOT OF PEOPLE HAD TO WRITE REALLY TIGHT CODE AND COME UP WITH REALLY CLEVER IDEAS TO DO THAT.
segments.textZh: 我认为，世界上许多最优秀的软件工程师都在电子游戏公司工作，或者职业生涯中的大部分时间都在那里度过，尤其是如果人们不得不尝试使用极少的计算能力来创造逼真的图像，那是一个困难的问题，因此许多人不得不编写非常精简的代码，并想出非常聪明的办法来做到这一点。

segments.textEn: IF YOU LOOK AT SOMEONE, AND AMAZING SOFTWARE ENGINEER AND A REALLY GOOD AEROSPACE ENGINEER, IT SHOWS PROBLEM SOLVING, FIGURE OUT SOFTWARE ENGINEERING, PROBLEM-SOLVING, IT TRANSFERS TO OTHER THINGS. >> THE BEST ANECDOTE BETWEEN VIDEO GAMES AND ROCKETS, GAMING AI IS SO MUCH HARDER. WHEN THE GAME CRASHES, HE PRICES REBOOT AND WHEN THE ROCKET CRASHES, A GIANT MASS SPREAD OVER SEVERAL MILES.
segments.textZh: 如果你看看某个人，一名出色的软件工程师和一名非常优秀的航空航天工程师，这体现了解决问题，弄懂软件工程、解决问题，这可以迁移到其他事情上。>> 电子游戏和火箭之间最好的轶事是，游戏人工智能要难得多。当游戏崩溃时，他定价重启，而当火箭坠毁时，一大堆东西会散布到数英里之外。

segments.textEn: >> THERE'S A JOKE ABOUT, IF REALITY WAS A VIDEO GAME THE GRAPHICS ARE GREAT BUT THE PLOT IS TERRIBLE. AND THE TIME IS REALLY LONG. >> HOW HAS THE STUFF ELON'S DONE INSPIRED OR AFFECTED WHAT YOU DO, TODD, IN YOUR WORLD? >> I MEAN, THE SPACE STUFF, AS WE LOOK AT STARFIELD'S, THAT'S REALLY KIND OF LOOK, OKAY, HOW ARE THESE THINGS GOING TO WORK IN THE FUTURE? GOT TO GO TO SPACE X LAST YEAR, THAT PLACE IS LIKE THE AVENGERS MEETS NASSAU.
segments.textZh: >> 有个笑话说，如果现实是一款电子游戏，画面很棒，但剧情很糟糕。而且时间真的很长。>> 埃隆所做的事情如何启发或影响了你在自己的世界中所做的事，托德？>> 我的意思是，太空方面的事情，当我们审视《星空》的时候，那实际上就有点像是看看，好吧，这些东西将来会怎样运作？去年有机会去了SpaceX，那个地方就像《复仇者联盟》遇上了拿骚。

segments.textEn: WHAT DO THOSE THINGS LOOK LIKE AS WE DO A SCIENCE-FICTION GAME? BUT THE OTHER STUFF, IN THE CARS AND SELF-DRIVING IS SOMETHING I'M PASSIONATE ABOUT BUT THAT DOESN'T AFFECT THE GAME STUFF. AND I KNOW THAT NOW YOU ARE PUTTING GAMES ON THE TESLA SO THAT'S DIFFERENT. >> YEAH. ACTUALLY, THANKS FOR HELPING OUT ON THAT, I APPRECIATE IT. >> WE TALKED ABOUT THAT, WOULDN'T IT BE PRETTY COOL? SO WE ARE WORKING TOGETHER. "SKYRIM" ON IT?
segments.textZh: 当我们制作一款科幻游戏时，那些东西会是什么样子？不过其他那些东西，汽车和自动驾驶，是我热衷的领域，但那不会影响游戏方面的事情。我知道你们现在正把游戏放到 Tesla 上，所以那就不一样了。>> 对。其实，谢谢你在那件事上提供帮助，我很感激。>> 我们谈过那件事，那不是会很酷吗？所以我们正在合作。把《Skyrim》放上去？

segments.textEn: WE ARE GOING TO START A LITTLE SMALLER. WE ARE WORKING ON "FALLOUT SHELTER" FOR THE CARS. IT WILL BE FREE, YOUR LITTLE DWELLERS ON THE SCREEN, THEY LIVE IN THE CAR IN SOME WAY. IT'S A GREAT STARTING POINT. >> HOW IS THIS GOING TO WORK WITH GAMES, YOU'VE TALKED ABOUT UNITY AND PORTING IT ALL, YOU HAVE TO BE PARKED WHEN YOU PLAY THESE? HOW DOES THIS WORK? >> YEAH, YOU HAVE TO PARK THE CAR. >> [LAUGHS] >> THE FUN POLICE MAKE US PARK THE CAR.
segments.textZh: 我们会从小一点的开始。我们正在为汽车开发《Fallout Shelter》。它会是免费的，你的小居民们会出现在屏幕上，他们会以某种方式住在车里。这是个很棒的起点。>> 游戏要怎么运行？你谈过 Unity 以及把一切都移植过去，玩这些游戏时必须停车吗？这要怎么运作？>> 对，你必须把车停好。>> [笑声] >> 扫兴警察要求我们把车停好。

segments.textEn: WE WERE ALSO GOING TO ENABLE PEOPLE TO WATCH VIDEOS, STREAMING. THROUGH THE BROWSER, TO WATCH NETFLIX OR WHATEVER. YOUTUBE, IF THE CAR IS PARKED. A CHARGING STATION IF YOU WANT TO WATCH SOMETHING, WATCH IT ON THE SCREEN IN THE CAR. BUT THE GENERAL PRINCIPLE, WHAT CAN WE DO TO MAKE THE CAR THE MOST FUN POSSIBLE? AND WHAT DO OTHER CARS NOT HAVE?
segments.textZh: 我们还打算让人们能够观看视频、流媒体。通过浏览器观看 Netflix 或其他东西。还有 YouTube，前提是车停着。如果你在充电站想看点什么，就在车里的屏幕上看。但总的原则是，我们能做些什么，让汽车尽可能有趣？以及其他汽车没有什么？

segments.textEn: SO IT SEEMS LIKE, WELL, YOU KNOW, IF YOU ARE JUST PARKED SOMEWHERE WAITING FOR SOMEBODY, FINISH AN APPOINTMENT, ON A ROAD TRIP IT WOULD BE PRETTY COOL IF YOU JUST GO TO THE CAR SCREEN AND PLAY SOME FUN GAME. AND WE ARE EXPLORING, HOW DO WE MAKE IT AS MUCH FUN AS POSSIBLE? YOU CAN ALREADY PLAY ALL OF THE OLD ATARI GAMES IN THE CAR, YOU CAN CONNECT AN XBOX OR PS FOR CONTROLLER AND HAVE A PRETTY GOOD CONTROL FEEDBACK.
segments.textZh: 所以看起来，嗯，你知道，如果你只是把车停在某个地方等人、等一个预约结束，或者在公路旅行途中，如果你能直接打开车载屏幕玩些有趣的游戏，那会很酷。我们正在探索，怎样才能让它尽可能有趣？你已经可以在车里玩所有老款 Atari 游戏了，可以连接 Xbox 或 PS 当作控制器，并获得相当不错的操控反馈。

segments.textEn: AND WE HAVE GENIUS MOVES AND -- YOU CAN MAKE THE FART SOUND LIKE IT'S COMING FROM ANY SEAT. >> THAT ACTUALLY IS THE FUNNIEST EASTER EGG. AND THE NAMES OF THE FART. THE FALCON HEAVY IS ONE OF THEM, I BELIEVE. >> EXACTLY. >> WE'VE GOT SOME CLIPS, RIGHT?
segments.textZh: 而且我们还有天才操作，还有——你可以让放屁声听起来像是从任意座位传出来的。>> 那其实是最好笑的彩蛋。还有那些屁声的名字。我记得其中一个是 Falcon Heavy。>> 没错。>> 我们有一些片段，对吧？

segments.textEn: >> I CAN SHOW YOU SOME CLIPS OF SOME UPCOMING GAMES IN THE CAR, IT'S MEANT TO BE, WHAT ARE SOME COOL GAMES PEOPLE MIGHT LIKE TO PLAY, HOW MUCH PEOPLE PLAY THEM, ADD THEM TO -- HIGHER ON THE LIST OR MAYBE PUT IT INTO AN ARCHIVE YOU CAN TAP TO DOWNLOAD. THE SCREEN WAS NOT ORIGINALLY MEANT AS A GAME PLAYER, DOESN'T HAVE THAT MUCH STORAGE.
segments.textZh: >> 我可以给你们看一些即将在车里推出的游戏片段，我们的想法是，大家可能喜欢玩哪些酷游戏、玩它们的人有多少，把它们加到——列表中更靠前的位置，或者也许放进一个你可以点按下载的存档库里。这个屏幕最初并不是作为游戏机设计的，没有那么多存储空间。

segments.textEn: SO IT WOULDN'T HAVE THAT MANY GAMES ON IT AT ONE TIME BUT IT WOULD BE LIKE -- WHAT DO PEOPLE ENJOY PLAYING, A GOOD WAY TO PASS TIME. >> LET'S TAKE A LOOK AT GAMES ON TESLA. ♪ ♪ [APPLAUSE] >> WE'VE GOT A SECOND ONE, TOO? >> WE GOT A RACING GAME, SINGLE PLAYER OR TWO PLAYER. >> GAME TWO, CHECK IT OUT. ♪ ♪ [APPLAUSE] >> THE STEERING WHEEL, I WASN'T PREPARED FOR THAT, THAT'S PRETT.
segments.textZh: 所以它不会同时装那么多游戏，但会像是——人们喜欢玩什么、什么是消磨时间的好办法。>> 我们来看看 Tesla 上的游戏。♪ ♪ [掌声] >> 我们还有第2个，对吗？>> 我们有一款赛车游戏，可以单人或双人游玩。>> 第2款游戏，来看看。♪ ♪ [掌声] >> 方向盘，我没料到这个，真是挺漂。

segments.textEn: >> IF YOU HAVE A RACING GAME AND YOU HAVE A STEERING WHEEL SITTING RIGHT THERE, WAITING TO BE STEERED. >> TO GAS AND BRAKE, WILL THAT WORK, TOO? >> YEAH. THE BREAK IS WIRED IN AND I THINK WE WILL PROBABLY HAVE MAYBE THE SCROLL WHEEL FOR THE GAS PEDAL SO WE DON'T ACCIDENTALLY -- STEPPING ON THE BREAK IF YOU ARE STATIONARY IS NOT A PROBLEM. >> THE GAS COULD BE. THAT'S AMAZING. THAT'S SO COOL THAT YOU'RE DOING THAT INSIDE THE CAUSE.
segments.textZh: >> 如果你有一款赛车游戏，而那里正好就有一个方向盘，等着被转动。>> 油门和刹车也能用吗？>> 对。中断是接线连接的，我想我们可能会用滚轮来控制油门踏板，这样我们就不会意外——如果你静止不动，踩到中断不是问题。>> 油门可能会是问题。太不可思议了。你们在原因里面做这个，太酷了。

segments.textEn: I WANT TO ASK YOU THE IDEA, YOU ARE BOTH CERTAINLY KNOWN FOR A TON OF INCREDIBLE SUCCESSES IN YOUR CAREERS. HE SAID BEFORE, SOMETIMES YOU'RE REALLY ONLY INNOVATING IF YOU'RE READY TO FAIL OR HAVE FAILURE ALONG THE WAY, SHOWS THAT YOU ARE PUSHING RENOVATION. TODD, YOU'VE BEEN THROUGH QUITE A YEAR, CAN YOU GUYS MAY BE RARE LITTLE BIT ON SWORD OUT OF THE FOR INNOVATION AND HOW SOMETIMES FAILURE IS PART OF THAT JOURNEY?
segments.textZh: 我想问问你们这个想法，你们2位的职业生涯无疑都以大量不可思议的成功而闻名。他之前说过，有时候，只有当你准备好失败，或者一路上经历失败时，你才算真正在创新，这表明你在推动革新。Todd，你经历了相当不平凡的1年，你们能不能也许就“为创新而拔出的剑”这一罕见之处稍微谈一点，以及为什么失败有时是这段旅程的一部分？

segments.textEn: >> USUALLY WHEN YOU GET TO GAMING, THE FIRST TIME YOU SEE IT, YOU'VE GOT SUCCESSFUL AND YOU GOT THERE BY TRYING BIG NEW THINGS AND WE ARE GOING TO KEEP DOING THAT, OTHER GAME MAKERS DO THAT AND I THINK IT'S GOOD THAT THE AUDIENCES ARE WELCOMING TO THAT. THEY ARE GOING TO TRY IT OUT AND SUPPORT US AS WE GO THROUGH THAT PROCESS TO FIGURE OUT, HEY, WHAT'S GOING TO MAKE THIS TAX?
segments.textZh: >> 通常，当你进入游戏领域时，第一次看到它，你已经成功了，而你是通过尝试宏大而新颖的东西走到那里的，我们会继续这样做，其他游戏制作者也会这样做，我认为观众对此持欢迎态度是件好事。他们会尝试，并在我们经历这个过程、努力弄清楚“嘿，怎样才能让这个征税？”时支持我们。

segments.textEn: WE HAD OUR UPS AND DOWNS WITH "FALLOUT 76" BUT OUR FANS ARE INCREDIBLE AND HAVE REALLY STUCK WITH US AND IT'S TURNED INTO ONE OF THE BEST ONLINE COMMUNITIES WE'VE EVER SEEN, IT'S FANTASTIC. >> THROUGH YOUR CAREER I'M SURE YOU'VE SEEN THAT, TOO, THE PROJECTS THAT TAKE TIME TO EVOLVE BUT THAT'S PART OF WHAT IT TAKES, I GUESS, HAVING THAT VISION AND PUSHING FOR IT.
segments.textZh: 我们和《Fallout 76》一起经历过起起伏伏，但我们的粉丝非常了不起，确实一直陪伴着我们，而它已经变成了我们见过的最优秀的线上社区之一，太棒了。>> 在你的职业生涯中，我相信你也见过这种情况，有些项目需要时间才能演变，但我想，这正是其中所需的一部分，要有那种愿景并推动它实现。

segments.textEn: >> SURE, IF YOU'RE GOING TO TRY SOMETHING INNOVATIVE, YOU ARE IN UNEXPLORED TERRITORY SO THE ODDS THAT SOMETHING WILL GO WRONG ARE PRETTY HIGH. IT'S ONLY IF YOU TRY TO DO SOMETHING THAT'S WELL UNDERSTOOD THAT THERE IS A LITTLE CHANCE OF FAILURE BUT THERE WILL NOT BE INTERESTING OR INNOVATIVE. FOR SURE, UNCHARTED TERRITORY WILL RESULT IN FAILURES NECESSARILY. OR YOU'RE NOT TRYING HARD ENOUG ENOUGH.
segments.textZh: >> 当然，如果你要尝试创新的东西，你就是身处未经探索的领域，所以出问题的概率相当高。只有当你试图做一些已被充分理解的事情时，失败的可能性才很小，但那不会有趣，也不会有创新性。可以肯定，未知领域必然会导致失败。否则就是你尝试得还不够够努力。

segments.textEn: >> SPEAKING OF UNCHARTED TERRITORY, YOU MENTIONED "STARFIELD" BUT OBVIOUSLY SPACE IS GOING TO BE A PART OF THAT.
